description.zh: 业务类型，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。
description.en: The business type. Separate multiple business types with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to specify all business types.

description.zh: 待查询的域名，多个用竖线（|）分割，不传查询全部。
description.en: The domain name to query. Separate multiple domain names with vertical lines (|). If you do not specify this parameter, all domain names are queried.

description.zh: 运营商，竖线分隔，全部填all。
description.en: The Internet service provider (ISP). Separate multiple ISPs with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to specify all ISPs.
The terminal type. Separate multiple terminal types with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to specify all terminal types.
The region. Separate multiple regions with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to specify all regions.
